_comment: Registry of in-article figure templates (docs/figures.md). Read by astro/src/data/figures.ts for rendering and by tools/lib/figures.mjs for validation, so both check the same ids and fields. Adding a template = an entry here + a component in astro/src/components/figures/ + a branch in DataFigure.astro.

kinds.photo: Raster photo, text-free (image model, tools/featured-image). Needs alt + brief.
kinds.illustration: Raster editorial illustration with a character, text-free (image model). Needs alt + brief.
kinds.infographic: Data graphic rendered as HTML from the article's own values. Real text, ja+en.
kinds.schematic: Steps / flow / process diagram rendered as HTML.
kinds.ui: Pseudo-interface (card, ticket, mock UI) rendered as HTML.
kinds.composite: Raster base plus an HTML overlay; any text lives in the overlay.
